why_best: It visually models the user conversion journey in real time, giving viewers an irresistible psychological cue to mirror the interaction on their own devices.
why_bad: A static visual graphic or a full-screen intrusion would derail the main content's pace without offering the viewer the satisfying visual feedback of a completed interaction.
trap: Rushing the post-interaction confirmation state, which robs the audience of seeing the visual reward of the completed action.
